typeDeclarations.source: export type PdfChildLaunchObserver = () => void;
export type PdfParseRun = PdfParseResult & { cached: boolean; parseId?: number; resultHash: string };
export type PdfParseResult = { contractVersion: string; inputSha256: string; status: PdfParseStatus; errorCode: PdfParseErrorCode | null; pages: PdfParsePage[] };
export type PdfParseStatus = "ok" | "no_text_layer" | "malformed_pdf" | "encrypted_pdf" | "unsupported_pdf" | "resource_limit";
export type PdfParseErrorCode = typeof PDF_PARSE_ERROR_CODES[number];
export type PdfParsePage = { pageNumber: number; width: number; height: number; rotation: number; text: string; layout: PdfLayoutItem[] };
export type PdfLayoutItem = { text: string; x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; font: string; hasEol?: boolean; dir?: string };

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

branches.expression: ctx.emitResult({ ok: true, batch: { requested: plan.documentIds.length, parsed: parses.length - failed.length, failed: failed.length, cursor: plan.cursor, nextCursor: plan.nextCursor, resume: failed.length ? { documentIds: failed.map((p: any) => p.documentId) } : null } })
branches.typescriptType: { ok: boolean; batch: { requested: number; parsed: number; failed: number; cursor: number; nextCursor: number | null; resume: { documentIds: any[]; } | null; }; }

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

oracle.expectation: For documents parse-pending, preserve planCurrentPdfParses; parseRegisteredPdfBatch. Output branches are exactly ctx.emitResult({ ok: true, batch: { requested: plan.documentIds.length, parsed: parses.length - failed.length, failed: failed.length, cursor: plan.cursor, nextCursor: plan.nextCursor, resume: failed.length ? { documentIds: failed.map((p: any) => p.documentId) } : null } }). Required nested fields and nullable/optional values are the declared types plus the explicit producer construction above; no transport envelope is added.

negativeCase.scenario: Reach this operation-specific failing handler guard (with valid actor/policy where required): --limit must be an integer between 1 and 100
negativeCase.expectation: The failing guard calls fatal with exactly "--limit must be an integer between 1 and 100"; prints that message plus newline to stderr, exits 2, and does not continue past the guard. Earlier source-defined storage/migration effects are not rolled back by this assertion.

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

producerDefinitions.source:
function mapBankAccountRow(row: any): BankAccount {
  return {
    id: Number(row.id),
    slug: row.slug,
    name: row.name,
    bankName: row.bank_name ?? null,
    registrationNo: row.registration_no ?? null,
    accountNo: row.account_no ?? null,
    iban: row.iban ?? null,
    bic: row.bic ?? null,
    accountOwner: row.account_owner ?? null,
    customerNo: row.customer_no ?? null,
    currency: row.currency,
    ledgerAccountNo: row.ledger_account_no ?? null,
    active: Number(row.active) === 1,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
  };
}

notes: CSV-headeren skal indeholde mindst kolonnerne: transaction_date, text, amount (valgfri: booking_date, currency, reference, amount_dkk, fx_rate_to_dkk).
Danske header-aliasser accepteres uden --profile: dato/date → transaction_date, tekst/beskrivelse → text, beløb/belob → amount, valuta → currency, ref/bilagsnummer → reference.
Datoer er YYYY-MM-DD. Delimiter (komma eller semikolon) detekteres automatisk fra headeren.
amount er i KRONER (decimal): POSITIVT beløb = penge IND på kontoen (indbetaling), NEGATIVT = penge UD (betaling/gebyr).
--profile <navn> bruges når en banks CSV ikke matcher standardformatet (fx 'danske-bank': semikolon, dd.mm.yyyy-datoer, dansk talformat). Uden --profile antages standardformatet.
--account <id|slug> knytter posterne til en bankkonto oprettet med 'bank-account add'.
Import-idempotens, fingerprint-felter og overlap-reimport er dokumenteret kanonisk i docs/bank-import-idempotency.md.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. notes: --document-id og --bank-transaction-id binder udgiften til et indlæst bilag og en importeret bankpost (heltal-id'er)
--expense-account: kontonummeret udgiften bogføres på (fx 3000 Software og SaaS)
--vat-treatment styrer momsbehandlingen; udelades den, udledes den af udgiftskontoens default_vat_code:
standard = dansk købsmoms 25 % løftes af bilaget
reverse_charge = udenlandsk servicekøb (EU eller ikke-EU), omvendt betalingspligt (ingen dansk moms på fakturaen; leverandøridentiteten vælger korrekt behandling)
representation = repræsentation, kun delvis momsfradrag efter de særlige regler
exempt = momsfri udgift, intet købsmomsfradrag

non_deductible = moms uden fradragsret (fx udenlandsk lokal skat eller bilag hos en ikke-momsregistreret virksomhed): hele bilaget bogføres brutto på udgiftskontoen, ingen 4000 Købsmoms-linje, momsen indgår i kostprisen. Kan vælges eksplicit også i et momsregistreret selskab.
Har kontoen ingen (eller en umappet) default_vat_code, er --vat-treatment påkrævet
--payment-account: betalingskontoen udgiften krediteres på; standard er 2000 (Bank) — sæt den kun, hvis betalingen kom fra en anden konto
Ved bilag i fremmed valuta og en bankpost i DKK bruges bankpostens DKK-beløb som afregning; mangler importeret fx_rate_to_dkk, udledes den deterministisk af bilagets bruttobeløb og DKK-afregningen.
--date: bogføringsdato YYYY-MM-DD; udelades den, bruges bankpostens dato

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. notes: --from / --to afgrænser perioden (begge YYYY-MM-DD, inklusive). Perioder af samme --kind må ikke overlappe.

--kind: vat_period (momsperiode for virksomhedens registrerede kadence — kræves af 'vat momsangivelse'), fiscal_year (regnskabsår — kræves af 'report annual'), custom. Standard: vat_period. vat_quarter accepteres kun som legacy-alias.
--status: 'closed' = perioden er afsluttet og bogføringen låst; 'reported' = derudover indberettet til myndigheden (SKAT/Erhvervsstyrelsen). Standard: closed.
Begge statusser låser bogføringen lige hårdt — forskellen er kun om indberetning er sket. Vælg 'reported' når du allerede har indsendt; ellers 'closed'.
--reference: valgfri fri tekst der gemmes på perioden (fx kvittering/journalnummer fra indberetningen).
--packet-hash og --review-id: PÅKRÆVET eksakt par fra 'period readiness' efterfulgt af 'period review'. En ændring i ledgeren gør pakken stale og lukningen afvises.

--confirm yes og actor er påkrævet. --force yes kræver desuden en levende owner-authorisation; lokal CLI failer lukket, fordi actor aldrig giver adgang. Åbne forhold gemmes som permanente obligationsposter.
En for tidligt lukket periode kan åbnes igen med 'period reopen' — en kontrolleret, fuldt revisionssporet handling. En 'reported'-periode (indberettet til myndigheden) kan dog ikke åbnes igen.

definition.companyResolution: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.actorAndConfirmation: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.

Branded numeric IDs serialize as numbers, not objects.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.

definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

oracle.expectation: For period close, preserve closeAccountingPeriod. Output branches are exactly ctx.emitResult(result as Record<string, unknown>). Required nested fields and nullable/optional values are the declared types plus the explicit producer construction above; no transport envelope is added.

negativeCase.scenario: Call period close --r01-contract-invalid value --format json (all other flags may be valid).
negativeCase.expectation: Before actor resolution, DB opening or handler execution, stderr is 'Unknown flag --r01-contract-invalid for period close.' followed by newline; exit 2; no structured business stdout and no business effects.

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

notes: --from / --to / --kind udpeger den lukkede periode der skal åbnes (samme værdier som ved 'period close').
--reason: PÅKRÆVET fri tekst der begrunder genåbningen. Begrundelsen gemmes ordret i den append-only audit-log sammen med aktør og tidsstempel.
Genåbningen ændrer ALDRIG den oprindelige periode-række — den tilføjer en ny audit-post. Hele luk/genåbn-historikken bevares og kan revideres.
Kræver en actor (--actor <user:...|agent:...|system:...> eller USER/LOGNAME/OPENCLAW_AGENT) så genåbningen er entydigt tilskrivbar.
En 'reported'-periode (allerede indberettet til SKAT/Erhvervsstyrelsen) kan IKKE åbnes igen — ret i stedet via en ny postering i en åben periode.

producerDefinitions.source: const PERIOD_RULE_ID = "DK-BOOKKEEPING-PERIOD-LOCK-001";
const PERIOD_KINDS = new Set<AccountingPeriodKind>(["vat_period", "vat_quarter", "fiscal_year", "custom"]);
const PERIOD_REOPEN_EVENT = "period_reopen";
const DEFAULT_VAT_PERIOD_TYPE: VatPeriodType = "quarter";

export function reviewPeriodCloseReadiness(db:Database,input:{packet:CloseReadinessPacket;reviewerActor:string;reviewerPrincipal?:CloseReviewPrincipal|null}):PeriodCloseReview { assertReviewSchema(db);const actor=input.reviewerActor.trim();if(!actor)throw new Error("reviewer actor is required");db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO period_close_readiness_packets(packet_hash,period_start,period_end,cutoff,packet_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.packet.hash,input.packet.periodStart,input.packet.periodEnd,input.packet.cutoff,canonicalCloseReadiness(input.packet));const p=db.query("SELECT id FROM period_close_readiness_packets WHERE packet_hash=?").get(input.packet.hash) as {id:number};const row=db.query("INSERT INTO period_close_reviews(packet_id,packet_hash,reviewer_actor,reviewer_principal) VALUES(?,?,?,?) RETURNING id,created_at").get(p.id,input.packet.hash,actor,principalJson(input.reviewerPrincipal)) as {id:number;created_at:string};return{id:row.id,packet:input.packet,reviewerActor:actor,reviewerPrincipal:input.reviewerPrincipal??null,createdAt:row.created_at}; }

export function recordPeriodCloseDecision(db:Database,input:{periodId:number;packet:CloseReadinessPacket;decision:"closed"|"forced_closed"|"reopened";actor:string;reason?:string;supersedesDecisionId?:number}):number{return(db.query("INSERT INTO period_close_decisions(period_id,packet_hash,decision,actor,reason,supersedes_decision_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?) RETURNING id").get(input.periodId,input.packet.hash,input.decision,input.actor,input.reason?.trim()||null,input.supersedesDecisionId??null)as{id:number}).id;}

export function latestPeriodCloseDecision(db:Database,periodId:number):number|undefined{return(db.query("SELECT id FROM period_close_decisions WHERE period_id=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get(periodId)as{id:number}|null)?.id;}

notes: transactionDate: YYYY-MM-DD (påkrævet)
text: tekst (påkrævet)
lines: mindst 2 linjer; hver linje { accountNo, debitAmount | creditAmount, vatCode?, text? }
vatCode skal være en understøttet, kanonisk kode. En manuel postering på en momskonto kræver koden på den reelle indtægts-/udgiftsgrundlinje; en kode på bank- eller momskontrollinjen tæller ikke.

Understøttede koder: DK_PURCHASE_25, DK_PURCHASE_EXEMPT, DK_SALE_25, DK_SALE_EXEMPT, EU_SERVICE_REVERSE_CHARGE, NON_EU_SERVICE_REVERSE_CHARGE, REPRESENTATION_SPECIAL, REPRESENTATION_NON_DEDUCTIBLE_VAT, DK_BAD_DEBT_25, REVERSE_CHARGE_EXEMPT, DOMESTIC_REVERSE_CHARGE_EXEMPT, OSS_EU_CONSUMER.
debitAmount/creditAmount: positivt beløb i KRONER (decimal, fx 1250.50) — ikke øre
Hver linje har enten debitAmount eller creditAmount, aldrig begge; sum debet == sum kredit
documentId: heltal — PÅKRÆVET når en linje rammer en udgifts- eller indtægtskonto (bilagsbevis)
sourceBankTransactionId: heltal — valgfrit, knytter posteringen til en banktransaktion og lukker dens UNMATCHED_BANK_TRANSACTION exception (fx ved aktivt-til-aktivt-postering som værdipapirhandel)
currency: valgfri 3-bogstavs ISO (standard "DKK")
Ved currency != DKK kræves desuden amountForeign, amountDkk og fxRateToDkk (beløb i KRONER)

definition.actorAndConfirmation: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: No central mutation gate for this key.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

branches.typescriptType: { ok: boolean; outPath: string | undefined; asOfDate: string; bytes: any; renderMs: number; commitSha: string; ruleBundleVersion: string; opened: boolean; }

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

branches.typescriptType: { ok: boolean; templateId?: number; appliedRules: string[]; errors: string[]; }

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

oracle.expectation: For recurring-invoice create, preserve createRecurringInvoiceTemplate. Output branches are exactly ctx.emitResult(result as Record<string, unknown>). Required nested fields and nullable/optional values are the declared types plus the explicit producer construction above; no transport envelope is added.

negativeCase.scenario: Call recurring-invoice create --r01-contract-invalid value --format json (all other flags may be valid).
negativeCase.expectation: Before actor resolution, DB opening or handler execution, stderr is 'Unknown flag --r01-contract-invalid for recurring-invoice create.' followed by newline; exit 2; no structured business stdout and no business effects.

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

function selectLinesInPeriod(db: Database, periodStart: string, periodEnd: string): LedgerLineRow[] {
  return db
    .query(
      `SELECT a.account_no AS account_no,
              a.name       AS account_name,
              a.type       AS account_type,
              a.normal_balance AS normal_balance,
              jl.debit_amount  AS debit_amount,
              jl.credit_amount AS credit_amount,
              je.id            AS entry_id
         FROM journal_entries je
         JOIN journal_lines jl ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id
         JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = jl.account_id
        WHERE je.transaction_date >= ? AND je.transaction_date <= ?
        ORDER BY a.account_no ASC, je.id ASC, jl.id ASC`,
    )
    .all(periodStart, periodEnd) as LedgerLineRow[];
}

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Compliance-rapport

${escapeHtml(input.companyName)}${cvr} · ${fiscalYear}Genereret ${escapeHtml(formatInstant(input.generatedAt))}

Forretningsmæssigt overblik

Denne rapport dokumenterer hvordan Rentemester driver bogføringen i overensstemmelse med dansk lovgivning. Rapporten er en deterministisk funktion af virksomhedens nuværende ledger-tilstand og det regel-bundle der er installeret — samme input giver byte-for-byte identisk output. Hash i bunden tillader en revisor at konstatere at en udleveret kopi ikke er ændret.

Rapporten dækker:

  • Integritet af bogføringen (hash-kæde + append-only)
  • Opbevaring og backup (5 års betryggende opbevaring + ugentlig sikkerhedskopi)
  • Periode-lukning og rettelser via reversal
  • GDPR-håndtering og retention-grænse for sletning
  • Regulatorisk dækning (citationer mod lovkorpusset)
  • Liste af regler og deres paragraf-hjemmel
  • Myndighedsudlevering, SAF-T og revisor-eksport
${body}
Rule bundle${escapeHtml(input.ruleBundleVersion)}
Commit${escapeHtml(input.commitSha ?? "—")}
Rapport-fingerprintsha256:${fingerprint}

Denne rapport er vejledende dokumentation til revisor eller myndighed. Den endelige juridiske vurdering er virksomhedens og dens rådgivers ansvar.

`; }

function authoritySection(): string { return `

8. Myndighedsudlevering og SAF-T

Rentemester kan på anmodning levere bogføringsmaterialet til en myndighed (Skattestyrelsen, Erhvervsstyrelsen) som en deterministisk eksport-pakke med SHA-256-manifest. Frist: 4 uger fra anmodningstidspunktet, jf. BEK 97 § 11 stk. 1.

  • rentemester system export-authority --requested-at <iso> --requester "Skattestyrelsen" --out <dir> — fuld pakke med bogføringsposter, bilag, banktransaktioner, audit-log og manifest.
  • rentemester system export-saft --from YYYY-MM-DD --to YYYY-MM-DD --out <dir> — SAF-T-eksport (Standard Audit File for Tax) for kontoplan, journal, salgs- og indkøbsfakturaer samt master-files.
  • rentemester system export-accountant --out <dir> — håndoff-pakke til revisor eller bogholder.

Hjemmel: BEK 97 §§ 10-11 (digitale standard bogføringssystemer skal stille materialet til rådighed inden for 4 uger).

`; }

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: No central mutation gate for this key.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

--registration-date: bogføringsdato for registreringsposteringen (standard: --first-date).
--document-id: heltal — bilags-id. Påkrævet hvis registreringen rammer en udgifts-/indtægtskonto (accrued_expense og deferred_revenue gør altid).

notes: --document-id binder kreditorposten til et indlæst købsbilag (heltal-id). Et bilag kan kun registreres som kreditorpost én gang.
--bill-date er bilagsdatoen (bogføringsdato for kreditorposteringen); --due-date er forfaldsdatoen gælden afdrages efter i kreditorlisten.
--expense-account: kontonummeret udgiften bogføres på (fx 3000 Software og SaaS).

--vat-treatment: 'standard' løfter 25 % dansk fradragsberettiget købsmoms af et bilag med verificerbar dansk leverandør (kun momsregistrerede selskaber); 'exempt' bogfører ingen moms; 'non_deductible' absorberer moms uden fradragsret (fx udenlandsk lokal skat eller § 37) i udgiften uden 4000-linje og kan vælges eksplicit også i et momsregistreret selskab. Udelades den, udledes den af bilagets vat_amount og selskabets registrering (>0 → 'standard' for et registreret selskab, men 'non_deductible' for et ikke-registreret; =0 → 'exempt'). 'standard' afvises for et ikke-registreret selskab eller uden dansk leverandøridentitet.
Kun DKK-bilag understøttes i denne første slice — fremmedvaluta er uden for scope.
Reverse charge / repræsentation hører til 'expense book' og modelleres ikke som kreditorpost.

definition.actorAndConfirmation: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. definition.companyResolution: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.actorAndConfirmation: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.

definition.serialization: JSON.stringify(value,null,2) + LF for structured results. JSON omits undefined object properties, converts undefined array entries and nonfinite numbers to null; no casing renaming. Source any/unknown describes genuinely unchecked values only where actual producer passes them through; SQL projection and JSON parsing below define their real dynamic shape. Branded numeric IDs serialize as numbers, not objects.

definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

branches.expression: ctx.emitResult(result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)
branches.typescriptType: { ok: true; companyKey: string; directionsRegistered: ParticipantDirection[]; network: DigisenseNetwork; participantType: ParticipantType; participantId: string; } | { ok: false; errors: string[]; }

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

negativeCase.scenario: Call efaktura registrer --r01-contract-invalid value --format json (all other flags may be valid).
negativeCase.expectation: Before actor resolution, DB opening or handler execution, stderr is 'Unknown flag --r01-contract-invalid for efaktura registrer.' followed by newline; exit 2; no structured business stdout and no business effects.

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

negativeCase.scenario: Call efaktura registrer-test-gln --r01-contract-invalid value --format json (all other flags may be valid).
negativeCase.expectation: Before actor resolution, DB opening or handler execution, stderr is 'Unknown flag --r01-contract-invalid for efaktura registrer-test-gln.' followed by newline; exit 2; no structured business stdout and no business effects.

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

function parse(input:unknown):IntercompanyDisposition {const row=input&&typeof input==="object"&&!Array.isArray(input)?input as any:{};const side=(name:DispositionSide)=>{const item=row[name]??{};const companySlug=text(item.companySlug,`${name}.companySlug`,120);const expectedSide=text(item.expectedSide,`${name}.expectedSide`,20);if(expectedSide!=="receivable"&&expectedSide!=="payable")throw new Error(`${name}.expectedSide must be receivable or payable`);return {companySlug,role:text(item.role,`${name}.role`,80),expectedSide:expectedSide as "receivable"|"payable"};};const left=side("left"),right=side("right");if(left.companySlug===right.companySlug)throw new Error("disposition sides must reference distinct legal companies");if(left.expectedSide===right.expectedSide)throw new Error("disposition sides must be complementary");const type=text(row.type,"type",20);if(!["invoice","reimbursement","loan","capital","dividend","repayment","other"].includes(type))throw new Error("unsupported disposition type");const ids=(value:unknown,name:string)=>{if(!Array.isArray(value)||!value.length||value.length>64)throw new Error(`${name} requires 1 through 64 source-linked references`);const out=value.map((v,i)=>text(v,`${name}[${i}]`,160));if(new Set(out).size!==out.length)throw new Error(`${name} must be unique`);return out.sort();};return {dispositionId:row.dispositionId?text(row.dispositionId,"dispositionId",80):`icd-${randomUUID()}`,type:type as any,economicDate:date(row.economicDate,"economicDate"),amount:amount(row.amount,"amount"),currency:text(row.currency,"currency",3).toUpperCase(),...(row.settlementDueDate?{settlementDueDate:date(row.settlementDueDate,"settlementDueDate")}:{ }),partyIds:ids(row.partyIds,"partyIds"),evidenceRecordIds:ids(row.evidenceRecordIds,"evidenceRecordIds"),left,right};}

function requireRecordAndParties(db:Database,row:IntercompanyDisposition){for(const id of row.partyIds)if(!inspectParty(db,id))throw new Error("disposition party does not exist");for(const id of row.evidenceRecordIds)if(!inspectCorporateRecord(db,id))throw new Error("disposition corporate evidence does not exist");}
const sha=(value:string)=>createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");

const canonical=(value:unknown):string=>value===null||typeof value!=="object"?JSON.stringify(value):Array.isArray(value)?`[${value.map(canonical).join(",")}]`:`{${Object.keys(value as object).sort().map(k=>`${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonical((value as any)[k])}`).join(",")}}`;
