producerDefinitions.source: export function proposeIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,input:unknown,audit:{actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){const value=parse(input);requireRecordAndParties(db,value);return db.transaction(()=>{const exists=state(db,value.dispositionId);const payload=canonical(value);if(exists){if(exists.payloadHash===sha(payload)&&exists.status==="proposed")return exists;throw new Error("disposition id already exists with a different or completed lifecycle");}db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_dispositions(disposition_id,canonical_payload,payload_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?)").run(value.dispositionId,payload,sha(payload),new Date().toISOString());event(db,value.dispositionId,"proposed",value,audit.actor,audit.principal);return state(db,value.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

function parse(input:unknown):IntercompanyDisposition {const row=input&&typeof input==="object"&&!Array.isArray(input)?input as any:{};const side=(name:DispositionSide)=>{const item=row[name]??{};const companySlug=text(item.companySlug,`${name}.companySlug`,120);const expectedSide=text(item.expectedSide,`${name}.expectedSide`,20);if(expectedSide!=="receivable"&&expectedSide!=="payable")throw new Error(`${name}.expectedSide must be receivable or payable`);return {companySlug,role:text(item.role,`${name}.role`,80),expectedSide:expectedSide as "receivable"|"payable"};};const left=side("left"),right=side("right");if(left.companySlug===right.companySlug)throw new Error("disposition sides must reference distinct legal companies");if(left.expectedSide===right.expectedSide)throw new Error("disposition sides must be complementary");const type=text(row.type,"type",20);if(!["invoice","reimbursement","loan","capital","dividend","repayment","other"].includes(type))throw new Error("unsupported disposition type");const ids=(value:unknown,name:string)=>{if(!Array.isArray(value)||!value.length||value.length>64)throw new Error(`${name} requires 1 through 64 source-linked references`);const out=value.map((v,i)=>text(v,`${name}[${i}]`,160));if(new Set(out).size!==out.length)throw new Error(`${name} must be unique`);return out.sort();};return {dispositionId:row.dispositionId?text(row.dispositionId,"dispositionId",80):`icd-${randomUUID()}`,type:type as any,economicDate:date(row.economicDate,"economicDate"),amount:amount(row.amount,"amount"),currency:text(row.currency,"currency",3).toUpperCase(),...(row.settlementDueDate?{settlementDueDate:date(row.settlementDueDate,"settlementDueDate")}:{ }),partyIds:ids(row.partyIds,"partyIds"),evidenceRecordIds:ids(row.evidenceRecordIds,"evidenceRecordIds"),left,right};}

function requireRecordAndParties(db:Database,row:IntercompanyDisposition){for(const id of row.partyIds)if(!inspectParty(db,id))throw new Error("disposition party does not exist");for(const id of row.evidenceRecordIds)if(!inspectCorporateRecord(db,id))throw new Error("disposition corporate evidence does not exist");}

function state(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash FROM rm_intercompany_dispositions WHERE disposition_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

const canonical=(value:unknown):string=>value===null||typeof value!=="object"?JSON.stringify(value):Array.isArray(value)?`[${value.map(canonical).join(",")}]`:`{${Object.keys(value as object).sort().map(k=>`${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonical((value as any)[k])}`).join(",")}}`;

function state(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash FROM rm_intercompany_dispositions WHERE disposition_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

export function linkIntercompanyDispositionJournal(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;side:DispositionSide;journalEntryId:number;expectedLedgerHeadHash:string|null;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.status!=="approved"&&current.status!=="partly_posted")throw new Error("only approved dispositions can link journals");if(current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("exact disposition hash is required");if(current.links.some((link:any)=>link.side===input.side)){const old=current.links.find((link:any)=>link.side===input.side)!;if(old.journal_entry_id===input.journalEntryId){assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);return current;}throw new Error("disposition side already has an immutable journal link");}assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);const expected=current.disposition[input.side];const actual=snapshot(workspace,expected.companySlug,input.journalEntryId);if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==input.expectedLedgerHeadHash)throw new Error("ledger head changed; refresh before linking");assertLinkMatches(current,input.side,actual);db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links(disposition_id,side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.dispositionId,input.side,expected.companySlug,input.journalEntryId,actual.entry.entry_no,actual.entry.entry_hash,actual.ledgerHeadHash,new Date().toISOString(),text(input.actor,"actor",160),input.principal.kind,text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160));lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception",{kind:"one_sided_posting",side:input.side,payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);if(current.links.length===1)lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception_resolved",{kind:"one_sided_posting",payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

const text=(value:unknown,name:string,max=160)=>{const result=typeof value==="string"?value.trim().normalize("NFC"):"";if(!result||result.length>max)throw new Error(`${name} is required and bounded`);return result;};

function assertCurrentLinks(workspace:string,current:NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof state>>){for(const link of current.links){const actual=snapshot(workspace,link.company_slug,link.journal_entry_id);if(actual.entry.entry_hash!==link.journal_entry_hash)throw new Error("linked journal entry changed; disposition requires review");if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==link.ledger_head_hash)throw new Error("linked ledger head changed; refresh and review before state change");}}

function snapshot(workspace:string,companySlug:string,journalEntryId:number){const db=openLedgerReadOnly(companyPaths(companyRootForSlug(workspace,companySlug)).db);try{db.exec("PRAGMA query_only=ON");const company=db.query("SELECT currency FROM companies WHERE id=1").get() as any;const entry=db.query("SELECT id,entry_no,transaction_date,entry_hash,status,reversal_of_entry_id FROM journal_entries WHERE id=?").get(journalEntryId)as any;if(!company||!entry||entry.status!=="posted"||entry.reversal_of_entry_id!=null)throw new Error("journal must be an active posted journal entry");const reversed=db.query("SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries WHERE reversal_of_entry_id=? LIMIT 1").get(journalEntryId);if(reversed)throw new Error("journal entry has been reversed");const lines=db.query("SELECT debit_amount,credit_amount FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_entry_id=?").all(journalEntryId)as any[];const head=db.query("SELECT entry_hash FROM journal_entries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get()as any;return {currency:String(company.currency).toUpperCase(),entry,lines,ledgerHeadHash:head?.entry_hash??null};}finally{db.close();}}

function assertLinkMatches(current:NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof state>>,side:DispositionSide,actual:ReturnType<typeof snapshot>){const expected=current.disposition[side];if(actual.currency!==current.disposition.currency)throw new Error("journal company currency does not match disposition currency");if(actual.entry.transaction_date!==current.disposition.economicDate)throw new Error("journal date does not match disposition economic date");const expectedAmount=Math.round(current.disposition.amount*100);const matched=actual.lines.some((line:any)=>Math.round(Number(expected.expectedSide==="receivable"?line.debit_amount:line.credit_amount)*100)===expectedAmount);if(!matched)throw new Error("journal does not contain the expected amount on the expected disposition side");}

function lifecycle(db:Database,id:string,type:"settled"|"superseded"|"reopened"|"exception"|"exception_resolved",payload:unknown,actor:string,principal:DispositionPrincipal){const previous=db.query("SELECT event_hash FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get() as any;const body=canonical(payload),digest=sha(body),at=new Date().toISOString(),hash=sha(canonical({previousHash:previous?.event_hash??null,dispositionId:id,type,payloadHash:digest,actor,principal,at}));db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events(disposition_id,event_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,previous_hash,event_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,type,digest,body,text(actor,"actor",160),principal.kind,text(principal.id,"principal id",160),previous?.event_hash??null,hash,at);insertWorkspaceAudit(db,{createdBy:actor,createdByProgram:"rentemester",eventType:`intercompany_disposition_${type}`,entityType:"intercompany_disposition",entityId:id});return {payloadHash:digest,eventHash:hash};}

refresh before linking");assertLinkMatches(current,input.side,actual);db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links(disposition_id,side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.dispositionId,input.side,expected.companySlug,input.journalEntryId,actual.entry.entry_no,actual.entry.entry_hash,actual.ledgerHeadHash,new Date().toISOString(),text(input.actor,"actor",160),input.principal.kind,text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160));lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception",{kind:"one_sided_posting",side:input.side,payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);if(current.links.length===1)lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception_resolved",{kind:"one_sided_posting",payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

function snapshot(workspace:string,companySlug:string,journalEntryId:number){const db=openLedgerReadOnly(companyPaths(companyRootForSlug(workspace,companySlug)).db);try{db.exec("PRAGMA query_only=ON");const company=db.query("SELECT currency FROM companies WHERE id=1").get() as any;const entry=db.query("SELECT id,entry_no,transaction_date,entry_hash,status,reversal_of_entry_id FROM journal_entries WHERE id=?").get(journalEntryId)as any;if(!company||!entry||entry.status!=="posted"||entry.reversal_of_entry_id!=null)throw new Error("journal must be an active posted journal entry");const reversed=db.query("SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries WHERE reversal_of_entry_id=? LIMIT 1").get(journalEntryId);if(reversed)throw new Error("journal entry has been reversed");const lines=db.query("SELECT debit_amount,credit_amount FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_entry_id=?").all(journalEntryId)as any[];const head=db.query("SELECT entry_hash FROM journal_entries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get()as any;return {currency:String(company.currency).toUpperCase(),entry,lines,ledgerHeadHash:head?.entry_hash??null};}finally{db.close();}}

function state(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash FROM rm_intercompany_dispositions WHERE disposition_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

export function settleIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;settlementEvidenceRecordIds:string[];actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(current.status==="settled")return current;if(current.status!=="posted")throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(!Array.isArray(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)||input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds.length<1)throw new Error("settlement requires source-linked evidence");for(const id of input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)if(!inspectCorporateRecord(db,text(id,"settlement evidence",160)))throw new Error("settlement corporate evidence does not exist");assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"settled",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,settlementEvidenceRecordIds:[...new Set(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)].sort()},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

const text=(value:unknown,name:string,max=160)=>{const result=typeof value==="string"?value.trim().normalize("NFC"):"";if(!result||result.length>max)throw new Error(`${name} is required and bounded`);return result;};

export function inspectCorporateRecord(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at,canonical_payload FROM rm_corporate_record_events WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}

function assertCurrentLinks(workspace:string,current:NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof state>>){for(const link of current.links){const actual=snapshot(workspace,link.company_slug,link.journal_entry_id);if(actual.entry.entry_hash!==link.journal_entry_hash)throw new Error("linked journal entry changed; disposition requires review");if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==link.ledger_head_hash)throw new Error("linked ledger head changed; refresh and review before state change");}}

function lifecycle(db:Database,id:string,type:"settled"|"superseded"|"reopened"|"exception"|"exception_resolved",payload:unknown,actor:string,principal:DispositionPrincipal){const previous=db.query("SELECT event_hash FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get() as any;const body=canonical(payload),digest=sha(body),at=new Date().toISOString(),hash=sha(canonical({previousHash:previous?.event_hash??null,dispositionId:id,type,payloadHash:digest,actor,principal,at}));db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events(disposition_id,event_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,previous_hash,event_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,type,digest,body,text(actor,"actor",160),principal.kind,text(principal.id,"principal id",160),previous?.event_hash??null,hash,at);insertWorkspaceAudit(db,{createdBy:actor,createdByProgram:"rentemester",eventType:`intercompany_disposition_${type}`,entityType:"intercompany_disposition",entityId:id});return {payloadHash:digest,eventHash:hash};}

function state(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash FROM rm_intercompany_dispositions WHERE disposition_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

export function reopenIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;reason:string;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||!["settled","superseded"].includes(current.status)||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("only exact settled or superseded dispositions can be reopened");assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"reopened",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,reason:text(input.reason,"reopen reason",1000)},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

function assertCurrentLinks(workspace:string,current:NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof state>>){for(const link of current.links){const actual=snapshot(workspace,link.company_slug,link.journal_entry_id);if(actual.entry.entry_hash!==link.journal_entry_hash)throw new Error("linked journal entry changed; disposition requires review");if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==link.ledger_head_hash)throw new Error("linked ledger head changed; refresh and review before state change");}}

function lifecycle(db:Database,id:string,type:"settled"|"superseded"|"reopened"|"exception"|"exception_resolved",payload:unknown,actor:string,principal:DispositionPrincipal){const previous=db.query("SELECT event_hash FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get() as any;const body=canonical(payload),digest=sha(body),at=new Date().toISOString(),hash=sha(canonical({previousHash:previous?.event_hash??null,dispositionId:id,type,payloadHash:digest,actor,principal,at}));db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events(disposition_id,event_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,previous_hash,event_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,type,digest,body,text(actor,"actor",160),principal.kind,text(principal.id,"principal id",160),previous?.event_hash??null,hash,at);insertWorkspaceAudit(db,{createdBy:actor,createdByProgram:"rentemester",eventType:`intercompany_disposition_${type}`,entityType:"intercompany_disposition",entityId:id});return {payloadHash:digest,eventHash:hash};}

function state(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash FROM rm_intercompany_dispositions WHERE disposition_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

export function supersedeIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;replacementDispositionId:string;reason:string;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash||["settled","superseded"].includes(current.status))throw new Error("active exact disposition is required for supersession");const replacement=text(input.replacementDispositionId,"replacement disposition id",80);if(replacement===input.dispositionId||!state(db,replacement))throw new Error("supersession requires a distinct existing replacement disposition");lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"superseded",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,replacementDispositionId:replacement,reason:text(input.reason,"supersession reason",1000)},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

branches.expression: ctx.emitResult({ ok: false, errors: [error instanceof Error ? error.message : "intercompany mapping validation failed"] })

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

oracle.expectation: For group validate-mapping, preserve resolveWorkspaceRoot; openWorkspaceControlReadOnlyDb; readCurrentGroupManifest; parseIntercompanyMapping. definition.companyResolution: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.actorAndConfirmation: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.

definition.serialization: JSON.stringify(value,null,2) + LF for structured results. JSON omits undefined object properties, converts undefined array entries and nonfinite numbers to null; no casing renaming. Source any/unknown describes genuinely unchecked values only where actual producer passes them through; SQL projection and JSON parsing below define their real dynamic shape. Branded numeric IDs serialize as numbers, not objects.

producerDefinitions.source: const GROUP_MANIFEST_VERSION = 1 as const;
const MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 256 * 1024;
const MAX_GROUPS = 128;
const MAX_ROWS_PER_GROUP = 1024;
const ACCOUNT = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/;

function id(value: unknown, label: string): string { const result = string(value, label); if (!IDENTIFIER.test(result)) throw new Error(`${label} must be a lowercase stable identifier`); return result; }
const IDENTIFIER = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/;
function string(value: unknown, label: string): string { if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) throw new Error(`${label} is required`); return value.trim().normalize("NFC"); }
function date(value: unknown, label: string): string { try { return parseGroupAsOf(value); } catch { throw new Error(`${label} must be a real ISO date`); } }
function compare(a: string, b: string): number { return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0; }

function covers(a: EffectiveInterval, b: EffectiveInterval): boolean { return a.validFrom <= b.validFrom && (a.validToExclusive == null || (b.validToExclusive != null && a.validToExclusive >= b.validToExclusive)); }

function overlaps(a: EffectiveInterval, b: EffectiveInterval): boolean { return (a.validToExclusive == null || b.validFrom < a.validToExclusive) && (b.validToExclusive == null || a.validFrom < b.validToExclusive); }

function refs(value: unknown, label: string): string[] { if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0 || value.length > 64) throw new Error(`${label} must contain 1 through 64 values`); const result = value.map((entry, index) => string(entry, `${label}[${index}]`)).sort(compare); if (new Set(result).size !== result.length || result.some((entry) => entry.length > 256)) throw new Error(`${label} is invalid`); return result; }

producerDefinitions.source: const GROUP_MANIFEST_VERSION = 1 as const;
const MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 256 * 1024;
const MAX_GROUPS = 128;
const MAX_ROWS_PER_GROUP = 1024;
const ACCOUNT = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/;

function id(value: unknown, label: string): string { const result = string(value, label); if (!IDENTIFIER.test(result)) throw new Error(`${label} must be a lowercase stable identifier`); return result; }
const IDENTIFIER = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/;
function string(value: unknown, label: string): string { if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) throw new Error(`${label} is required`); return value.trim().normalize("NFC"); }
function date(value: unknown, label: string): string { try { return parseGroupAsOf(value); } catch { throw new Error(`${label} must be a real ISO date`); } }
function compare(a: string, b: string): number { return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0; }

function covers(a: EffectiveInterval, b: EffectiveInterval): boolean { return a.validFrom <= b.validFrom && (a.validToExclusive == null || (b.validToExclusive != null && a.validToExclusive >= b.validToExclusive)); }

function overlaps(a: EffectiveInterval, b: EffectiveInterval): boolean { return (a.validToExclusive == null || b.validFrom < a.validToExclusive) && (b.validToExclusive == null || a.validFrom < b.validToExclusive); }

function refs(value: unknown, label: string): string[] { if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0 || value.length > 64) throw new Error(`${label} must contain 1 through 64 values`); const result = value.map((entry, index) => string(entry, `${label}[${index}]`)).sort(compare); if (new Set(result).size !== result.length || result.some((entry) => entry.length > 256)) throw new Error(`${label} is invalid`); return result; }

export function proposeConsolidationProfile(db: Database, workspaceRoot: string, input: unknown, audit: ResolveActorInput) { return db.transaction(() => { const groups = readCurrentGroupManifest(db, workspaceRoot); if (!groups) throw new Error("group structure is unavailable"); const profile = parseConsolidationProfile(input, groups.manifest); const state = current(readEvents(db)).get(profile.id); if (state && state.event_type !== "revoked") throw new Error("consolidation profile id already has an active lifecycle"); const event = append(db,"proposed",profile,audit); return { profileId: profile.id, profileHash: event.profile_hash, status: "proposed" as const }; }).immediate(); }

function current(events: readonly ProfileEvent[]): Map<string, ProfileEvent> { const result = new Map<string, ProfileEvent>(); for (const event of events) result.set(event.profile_id, event); return result; }

function readEvents(db: Database): ProfileEvent[] { const events = db.query("SELECT id,profile_id,event_type,profile_hash,canonical_profile,previous_hash,event_hash,actor,created_at FROM rm_consolidation_profile_events ORDER BY id").all() as ProfileEvent[]; let previous: string | null = null; for (const event of events) { if (event.previous_hash !== previous || event.event_hash !== eventHash(previous, event)) throw new Error("consolidation profile event hash-chain is invalid"); previous = event.event_hash; } return events; }

function append(db: Database, type: ProfileEvent["event_type"], profile: ConsolidationProfile, audit: ResolveActorInput): ProfileEvent { const events = readEvents(db); const previous = events.at(-1)?.event_hash ?? null; const body = canonicalizeConsolidationProfile(profile); if (Buffer.byteLength(body, "utf8") > 524288) throw new Error("consolidation profile exceeds 524288 bytes"); const actor = resolveActor(audit).auditActor; const event = { id: (events.at(-1)?.id ?? 0) + 1, profile_id: profile.id, event_type: type, profile_hash: sha(body), canonical_profile: body, previous_hash: previous, actor, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }; const complete: ProfileEvent = { ...event, event_hash: eventHash(previous, event) }; db.query("INSERT INTO rm_consolidation_profile_events (id,profile_id,event_type,profile_hash,canonical_profile,previous_hash,event_hash,actor,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(complete.id,complete.profile_id,complete.event_type,complete.profile_hash,complete.canonical_profile,complete.previous_hash,complete.event_hash,complete.actor,complete.created_at); insertWorkspaceAudit(db,{...audit,eventType:`consolidation_profile_${type}`,entityType:"consolidation_profile",entityId:profile.id}); return complete; }

producerDefinitions.source: export function readConsolidationProfileState(db: Database, workspaceRoot: string, profileId: string) { const groups=readCurrentGroupManifest(db,workspaceRoot); if(!groups) return null; const event=current(readEvents(db)).get(profileId); return event ? {profile:decoded(event,groups.manifest),profileHash:event.profile_hash,status:event.event_type,actor:event.actor} : null; }

function current(events: readonly ProfileEvent[]): Map<string, ProfileEvent> { const result = new Map<string, ProfileEvent>(); for (const event of events) result.set(event.profile_id, event); return result; }

function readEvents(db: Database): ProfileEvent[] { const events = db.query("SELECT id,profile_id,event_type,profile_hash,canonical_profile,previous_hash,event_hash,actor,created_at FROM rm_consolidation_profile_events ORDER BY id").all() as ProfileEvent[]; let previous: string | null = null; for (const event of events) { if (event.previous_hash !== previous || event.event_hash !== eventHash(previous, event)) throw new Error("consolidation profile event hash-chain is invalid"); previous = event.event_hash; } return events; }

function decoded(event: ProfileEvent, groups: GroupManifest): ConsolidationProfile { const profile = parseConsolidationProfile(JSON.parse(event.canonical_profile), groups); if (profile.id !== event.profile_id || sha(event.canonical_profile) !== event.profile_hash) throw new Error("consolidation profile evidence is invalid"); return profile; }

export function approveConsolidationProfile(db: Database, workspaceRoot: string, profileId: string, profileHash: string, audit: ResolveActorInput) { return db.transaction(() => { const groups = readCurrentGroupManifest(db,workspaceRoot); if (!groups) throw new Error("group structure is unavailable"); const event = current(readEvents(db)).get(profileId); if (!event || event.event_type !== "proposed" || event.profile_hash !== profileHash) throw new Error("exact pending consolidation profile was not found"); if (resolveActor(audit).auditActor === event.actor) throw new Error("consolidation profile approval requires a distinct reviewer"); const profile = decoded(event,groups.manifest); append(db,"approved",profile,audit); return { profileId,profileHash,status:"approved" as const }; }).immediate(); }

function append(db: Database, type: ProfileEvent["event_type"], profile: ConsolidationProfile, audit: ResolveActorInput): ProfileEvent { const events = readEvents(db); const previous = events.at(-1)?.event_hash ?? null; const body = canonicalizeConsolidationProfile(profile); if (Buffer.byteLength(body, "utf8") > 524288) throw new Error("consolidation profile exceeds 524288 bytes"); const actor = resolveActor(audit).auditActor; const event = { id: (events.at(-1)?.id ?? 0) + 1, profile_id: profile.id, event_type: type, profile_hash: sha(body), canonical_profile: body, previous_hash: previous, actor, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }; const complete: ProfileEvent = { ...event, event_hash: eventHash(previous, event) }; db.query("INSERT INTO rm_consolidation_profile_events (id,profile_id,event_type,profile_hash,canonical_profile,previous_hash,event_hash,actor,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(complete.id,complete.profile_id,complete.event_type,complete.profile_hash,complete.canonical_profile,complete.previous_hash,complete.event_hash,complete.actor,complete.created_at); insertWorkspaceAudit(db,{...audit,eventType:`consolidation_profile_${type}`,entityType:"consolidation_profile",entityId:profile.id}); return complete; }

producerDefinitions.source: export function readConsolidationProfileState(db: Database, workspaceRoot: string, profileId: string) { const groups=readCurrentGroupManifest(db,workspaceRoot); if(!groups) return null; const event=current(readEvents(db)).get(profileId); return event ? {profile:decoded(event,groups.manifest),profileHash:event.profile_hash,status:event.event_type,actor:event.actor} : null; }

function current(events: readonly ProfileEvent[]): Map<string, ProfileEvent> { const result = new Map<string, ProfileEvent>(); for (const event of events) result.set(event.profile_id, event); return result; }

function readEvents(db: Database): ProfileEvent[] { const events = db.query("SELECT id,profile_id,event_type,profile_hash,canonical_profile,previous_hash,event_hash,actor,created_at FROM rm_consolidation_profile_events ORDER BY id").all() as ProfileEvent[]; let previous: string | null = null; for (const event of events) { if (event.previous_hash !== previous || event.event_hash !== eventHash(previous, event)) throw new Error("consolidation profile event hash-chain is invalid"); previous = event.event_hash; } return events; }

function decoded(event: ProfileEvent, groups: GroupManifest): ConsolidationProfile { const profile = parseConsolidationProfile(JSON.parse(event.canonical_profile), groups); if (profile.id !== event.profile_id || sha(event.canonical_profile) !== event.profile_hash) throw new Error("consolidation profile evidence is invalid"); return profile; }

export function revokeConsolidationProfile(db: Database, workspaceRoot: string, profileId: string, audit: ResolveActorInput) { return db.transaction(() => { const groups=readCurrentGroupManifest(db,workspaceRoot); if(!groups) throw new Error("group structure is unavailable"); const event=current(readEvents(db)).get(profileId); if(!event||event.event_type!=="approved") throw new Error("approved consolidation profile was not found"); append(db,"revoked",decoded(event,groups.manifest),audit); return {profileId,status:"revoked" as const}; }).immediate(); }

function append(db: Database, type: ProfileEvent["event_type"], profile: ConsolidationProfile, audit: ResolveActorInput): ProfileEvent { const events = readEvents(db); const previous = events.at(-1)?.event_hash ?? null; const body = canonicalizeConsolidationProfile(profile); if (Buffer.byteLength(body, "utf8") > 524288) throw new Error("consolidation profile exceeds 524288 bytes"); const actor = resolveActor(audit).auditActor; const event = { id: (events.at(-1)?.id ?? 0) + 1, profile_id: profile.id, event_type: type, profile_hash: sha(body), canonical_profile: body, previous_hash: previous, actor, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }; const complete: ProfileEvent = { ...event, event_hash: eventHash(previous, event) }; db.query("INSERT INTO rm_consolidation_profile_events (id,profile_id,event_type,profile_hash,canonical_profile,previous_hash,event_hash,actor,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(complete.id,complete.profile_id,complete.event_type,complete.profile_hash,complete.canonical_profile,complete.previous_hash,complete.event_hash,complete.actor,complete.created_at); insertWorkspaceAudit(db,{...audit,eventType:`consolidation_profile_${type}`,entityType:"consolidation_profile",entityId:profile.id}); return complete; }

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.

definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

producerDefinitions.source: const MANIFEST_VERSION = 1 as const;

export function readConsolidationProfileState(db: Database, workspaceRoot: string, profileId: string) { const groups=readCurrentGroupManifest(db,workspaceRoot); if(!groups) return null; const event=current(readEvents(db)).get(profileId); return event ? {profile:decoded(event,groups.manifest),profileHash:event.profile_hash,status:event.event_type,actor:event.actor} : null; }
function active(interval: EffectiveInterval, asOf: string): boolean { return interval.validFrom <= asOf && (interval.validToExclusive == null || asOf < interval.validToExclusive); }

const add=(lineId:string,companySlug:string,ore:bigint,sourceHash:string)=>{const companiesForLine=byLine.get(lineId)??new Map(); const value=companiesForLine.get(companySlug)??{ore:0n,sourceHashes:[]}; value.ore+=ore; value.sourceHashes.push(sourceHash); companiesForLine.set(companySlug,value); byLine.set(lineId,companiesForLine);};
function sha(value: string): string { return createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex"); }
function compare(a: string, b: string): number { return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0; }
const total=(section:ReportSection)=>figures!.filter(line=>line.section===section).reduce((sum,line)=>sum+toOre(line.consolidatedAmount),0n);

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.
definition.company: Company root when requested by handler: trimmed --company takes precedence over RENTEMESTER_COMPANY; no default. Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. oracle.expectation: For posting-rules supersede, preserve the handler-local projection/transport operation. Output branches are exactly ctx.emitResult(result). negativeCase.scenario: Reach this operation-specific failing handler guard (with valid actor/policy where required): --rule-id, --version, --expected-payload-hash, --rationale, --provenance and --actor are required
negativeCase.expectation: The failing guard calls fatal with exactly "--rule-id, --version, --expected-payload-hash, --rationale, --provenance and --actor are required"; prints that message plus newline to stderr, exits 2, and does not continue past the guard. effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. producerDefinitions.source: function scope(db: Database, input: { companyId?: number; accountingFrom: string; accountingTo: string; bankFrom: string; bankTo: string }) { const companyId = selectedCompanyId(db); if (input.companyId !== undefined && input.companyId !== companyId) throw new Error("company identity is derived from the selected ledger"); const result = { companyId, accountingFrom: input.accountingFrom, accountingTo: input.accountingTo, bankFrom: input.bankFrom, bankTo: input.bankTo }; if (![result.accountingFrom, result.accountingTo, result.bankFrom, result.bankTo].every(date) || result.accountingFrom > result.accountingTo || result.bankFrom > result.bankTo) throw new Error("ordered explicit ISO accounting and bank date ranges are required"); return result; }
const systemVatValidationClock: VatValidationClock = { now: () => new Date() };
function evidenceHash(evidence: PurchaseEvidence) { return hash({ document: evidence.document, bank: evidence.bank }); }
function hash(value: unknown) { return createHash("sha256").update(canonical(value)).digest("hex"); }

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. negativeCase.scenario: Reach this operation-specific failing handler guard (with valid actor/policy where required): --run-key is required

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

producerDefinitions.source: function scope(db: Database, input: { companyId?: number; accountingFrom: string; accountingTo: string; bankFrom: string; bankTo: string }) { const companyId = selectedCompanyId(db); if (input.companyId !== undefined && input.companyId !== companyId) throw new Error("company identity is derived from the selected ledger"); const result = { companyId, accountingFrom: input.accountingFrom, accountingTo: input.accountingTo, bankFrom: input.bankFrom, bankTo: input.bankTo }; if (![result.accountingFrom, result.accountingTo, result.bankFrom, result.bankTo].every(date) || result.accountingFrom > result.accountingTo || result.bankFrom > result.bankTo) throw new Error("ordered explicit ISO accounting and bank date ranges are required"); return result; }

function evidenceHash(evidence: PurchaseEvidence) { return hash({ document: evidence.document, bank: evidence.bank }); }
function hash(value: unknown) { return createHash("sha256").update(canonical(value)).digest("hex"); }
function validActor(actor: string | undefined): actor is string { return typeof actor === "string" && /^(user|agent|system):[^\s]+$/.test(actor); }

producerDefinitions.source: export function approveBookkeepingBatchPlan(db: Database, input: BatchActor & { principal?: BatchPrincipal; runId: number; planHash: string }) { if (!validActor(input.actor)) throw new Error("actor is required"); const principal=batchPrincipal(db,input); return db.transaction(() => { const revision = db.query("SELECT id,planner_kind,planner_subject_id FROM bookkeeping_batch_revisions WHERE run_id=? AND revision_hash=?").get(input.runId,input.planHash) as {id:number;planner_kind:BatchPrincipal['kind'];planner_subject_id:string}|null; if (!revision) throw new Error("exact pending plan was not found"); if (revision.planner_kind===principal.kind && revision.planner_subject_id===principal.subjectId) throw new Error("SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN"); const existing=db.query("SELECT 1 FROM bookkeeping_batch_revision_approvals WHERE revision_id=?").get(revision.id); if (!existing) { db.query("INSERT INTO bookkeeping_batch_revision_approvals(revision_id,principal_kind,principal_subject_id,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)").run(revision.id,principal.kind,principal.subjectId,input.actor,new Date().toISOString()); event(db,input.runId,"approved",input.planHash,input.actor,{principal:{kind:principal.kind,subjectId:principal.subjectId}}); } return { ok: true as const }; }).immediate(); }
function validActor(actor: string | undefined): actor is string { return typeof actor === "string" && /^(user|agent|system):[^\s]+$/.test(actor); }

function event(db: Database, runId: number, type: "planned" | "approved" | "apply_started" | "final_checks" | "completed", planHash: string, actor: string, detail: unknown = {}) { db.query("INSERT INTO bookkeeping_batch_events(run_id,event_type,plan_hash,actor,detail_json,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(runId, type, planHash, actor, canonical(detail), new Date().toISOString()); }

export function inspectParty(db: Database, partyId:string) { const created=db.query("SELECT canonical_kind,canonical_payload FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='created'").get(partyId) as {canonical_kind:PartyKind;canonical_payload:string}|null; if(!created)return null; const history=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY id").all(partyId); const roles=db.query("SELECT company_slug,role,defaults_json FROM rm_party_company_roles WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY company_slug,role").all(partyId); const aliases=db.query("SELECT alias,source,observed_at,review_state,payload_hash FROM rm_party_alias_assertions WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY id").all(partyId); const assertions=db.query("SELECT field,value,source,observed_at,review_state,payload_hash FROM rm_party_field_assertions WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY id").all(partyId); return {partyId,kind:created.canonical_kind,...JSON.parse(created.canonical_payload),aliases:aliases.length?aliases:JSON.parse(created.canonical_payload).aliases.map((alias:string)=>({alias,source:"legacy-created",observed_at:null,review_state:"approved",payload_hash:null})),assertions,roles:roles.map((r:any)=>({companySlug:r.company_slug,role:r.role,defaults:JSON.parse(r.defaults_json)})),history}; }

AND event_type='created'").get(partyId) as {canonical_kind:PartyKind;canonical_payload:string}|null; if(!created)return null; const history=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY id").all(partyId); const roles=db.query("SELECT company_slug,role,defaults_json FROM rm_party_company_roles WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY company_slug,role").all(partyId); const aliases=db.query("SELECT alias,source,observed_at,review_state,payload_hash FROM rm_party_alias_assertions WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY id").all(partyId); const assertions=db.query("SELECT field,value,source,observed_at,review_state,payload_hash FROM rm_party_field_assertions WHERE party_id=? ORDER BY id").all(partyId); return {partyId,kind:created.canonical_kind,...JSON.parse(created.canonical_payload),aliases:aliases.length?aliases:JSON.parse(created.canonical_payload).aliases.map((alias:string)=>({alias,source:"legacy-created",observed_at:null,review_state:"approved",payload_hash:null})),assertions,roles:roles.map((r:any)=>({companySlug:r.company_slug,role:r.role,defaults:JSON.parse(r.defaults_json)})),history}; }

producerDefinitions.source: export function ingestCorporateRecord(db:Database,input:{recordId?:string;type:RecordType;bytes:Uint8Array;filename:string;source:string;receivedAt:string;recordDate?:string;retentionUntil?:string;uploader:string;sensitivity?:"normal"|"confidential"|"restricted";actor:string;links?:Array<{type:LinkType;id:string}>}) { if(!TYPES.includes(input.type))throw new Error("unsupported corporate record type");if(!input.bytes.byteLength)throw new Error("original bytes are required");if(input.bytes.byteLength>16*1024*1024)throw new Error("original bytes exceed 16 MiB bound");const id=input.recordId?requireText(input.recordId,"recordId",64):`record-${randomUUID()}`,sha256=hash(input.bytes),receivedAt=iso(input.receivedAt,"receivedAt"), sensitivity=input.sensitivity??"normal";const payload={type:input.type,sha256,filename:requireText(input.filename,"filename"),source:requireText(input.source,"source"),receivedAt,recordDate:input.recordDate?iso(input.recordDate,"recordDate"):null,retentionUntil:input.retentionUntil?iso(input.retentionUntil,"retentionUntil"):null,uploader:requireText(input.uploader,"uploader",160),sensitivity};db.transaction(()=>{const existing=db.query("SELECT sha256 FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(id)as{sha256:string}|null;if(existing){if(existing.sha256!==sha256)throw new Error("recordId is immutable and already has different bytes");return;}const duplicate=db.query("SELECT record_id FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE sha256=?").get(sha256)as{record_id:string}|null;if(duplicate)throw new Error("duplicate bytes require explicit shared-record linking, not automatic merge");for(const link of input.links??[])assertLinkTarget(db,link.type,requireText(link.id,"link id",256));db.query("INSERT INTO rm_corporate_record_bytes(record_id,original_bytes,sha256,filename,source,received_at,record_date,retention_until,uploader,sensitivity) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,input.bytes,sha256,payload.filename,payload.source,receivedAt,payload.recordDate,payload.retentionUntil,payload.uploader,sensitivity);append(db,id,input.type,"ingested",payload,input.actor,receivedAt);for(const link of input.links??[])linkCorporateRecord(db,{recordId:id,...link,actor:input.actor,at:receivedAt});})();return inspectCorporateRecord(db,id)!; }

const TYPES=["incorporation","articles","registration","shareholder_register","shareholder_agreement","board_resolution","general_meeting_minutes","capital_or_dividend_resolution","annual_report","auditor_deliverable","intercompany_agreement","ownership_register","share_transfer","authority_letter","bank_mandate","tax_registration","other"] as const;
const requireText=(value:unknown,label:string,max=320)=>{const out=typeof value==="string"?value.trim():"";if(!out||out.length>max)throw new Error(`${label} is required and bounded`);return out;};
const hash=(v:Uint8Array|string)=>createHash("sha256").update(v).digest("hex");
const iso=(value:unknown,label:string)=>{const date=new Date(requireText(value,label,40));if(Number.isNaN(date.valueOf()))throw new Error(`${label} must be ISO-8601`);return date.toISOString();};

function assertLinkTarget(db:Database,type:LinkType,id:string) { if(type==="party" && !db.query("SELECT 1 FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='created'").get(id)) throw new Error("linked party does not exist"); }

function append(db:Database,id:string,type:RecordType,event:string,payload:object,actor:string,at:string){const body=canonical(payload),digest=hash(body);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_events(record_id,event_type,record_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,event,storageType(type),digest,body,requireText(actor,"actor",160),at);return digest;}

export function linkCorporateRecord(db:Database,input:{recordId:string;type:LinkType;id:string;actor:string;at?:string}) {if(!["company","party","ownership","disposition","legacy_evidence_ref"].includes(input.type))throw new Error("unsupported record link type");const record=inspectCorporateRecord(db,input.recordId);if(!record)throw new Error("corporate record not found");const id=requireText(input.id,"link id",256);assertLinkTarget(db,input.type,id);db.transaction(()=>{const at=input.at?iso(input.at,"at"):new Date().toISOString();db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_links(record_id,link_type,link_id) VALUES(?,?,?)").run(input.recordId,input.type,id);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions(record_id,scope_kind,scope_id,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.recordId,input.type,id,requireText(input.actor,"actor",160),at);append(db,input.recordId,record.type,"linked",{type:input.type,id},input.actor,at);})();return inspectCorporateRecord(db,input.recordId)!;}

export function inspectCorporateRecord(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at,canonical_payload FROM rm_corporate_record_events WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}

definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.

Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

oracle.expectation: For corporate-record ingest, preserve openWorkspaceControlDb; ingestCorporateRecord. Output branches are exactly ctx.emitResult({ok:true,record:ingestCorporateRecord(db,{...input,bytes,actor:actor(ctx)} as any)}). Required nested fields and nullable/optional values are the declared types plus the explicit producer construction above; no transport envelope is added.

negativeCase.scenario: Call corporate-record ingest --r01-contract-invalid value --format json (all other flags may be valid).
negativeCase.expectation: Before actor resolution, DB opening or handler execution, stderr is 'Unknown flag --r01-contract-invalid for corporate-record ingest.' followed by newline; exit 2; no structured business stdout and no business effects.

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

producerDefinitions.source: export function linkCorporateRecord(db:Database,input:{recordId:string;type:LinkType;id:string;actor:string;at?:string}) {if(!["company","party","ownership","disposition","legacy_evidence_ref"].includes(input.type))throw new Error("unsupported record link type");const record=inspectCorporateRecord(db,input.recordId);if(!record)throw new Error("corporate record not found");const id=requireText(input.id,"link id",256);assertLinkTarget(db,input.type,id);db.transaction(()=>{const at=input.at?iso(input.at,"at"):new Date().toISOString();db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_links(record_id,link_type,link_id) VALUES(?,?,?)").run(input.recordId,input.type,id);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions(record_id,scope_kind,scope_id,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.recordId,input.type,id,requireText(input.actor,"actor",160),at);append(db,input.recordId,record.type,"linked",{type:input.type,id},input.actor,at);})();return inspectCorporateRecord(db,input.recordId)!;}

export function inspectCorporateRecord(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at,canonical_payload FROM rm_corporate_record_events WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}
const requireText=(value:unknown,label:string,max=320)=>{const out=typeof value==="string"?value.trim():"";if(!out||out.length>max)throw new Error(`${label} is required and bounded`);return out;};

function assertLinkTarget(db:Database,type:LinkType,id:string) { if(type==="party" && !db.query("SELECT 1 FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='created'").get(id)) throw new Error("linked party does not exist"); }
const iso=(value:unknown,label:string)=>{const date=new Date(requireText(value,label,40));if(Number.isNaN(date.valueOf()))throw new Error(`${label} must be ISO-8601`);return date.toISOString();};

function append(db:Database,id:string,type:RecordType,event:string,payload:object,actor:string,at:string){const body=canonical(payload),digest=hash(body);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_events(record_id,event_type,record_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,event,storageType(type),digest,body,requireText(actor,"actor",160),at);return digest;}

producerDefinitions.source: export function enrichCorporateRecord(db:Database,input:{recordId:string;assertion:string;actor:string;at?:string}){const record=inspectCorporateRecord(db,input.recordId);if(!record)throw new Error("corporate record not found");return append(db,input.recordId,record.type,"enriched",{assertion:requireText(input.assertion,"assertion",2000)},input.actor,input.at?iso(input.at,"at"):new Date().toISOString());}

export function inspectCorporateRecord(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at,canonical_payload FROM rm_corporate_record_events WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}

function append(db:Database,id:string,type:RecordType,event:string,payload:object,actor:string,at:string){const body=canonical(payload),digest=hash(body);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_events(record_id,event_type,record_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,event,storageType(type),digest,body,requireText(actor,"actor",160),at);return digest;}
const requireText=(value:unknown,label:string,max=320)=>{const out=typeof value==="string"?value.trim():"";if(!out||out.length>max)throw new Error(`${label} is required and bounded`);return out;};
const iso=(value:unknown,label:string)=>{const date=new Date(requireText(value,label,40));if(Number.isNaN(date.valueOf()))throw new Error(`${label} must be ISO-8601`);return date.toISOString();};

Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.actorAndConfirmation: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.

definition.serialization: JSON.stringify(value,null,2) + LF for structured results. JSON omits undefined object properties, converts undefined array entries and nonfinite numbers to null; no casing renaming. Source any/unknown describes genuinely unchecked values only where actual producer passes them through; SQL projection and JSON parsing below define their real dynamic shape. Branded numeric IDs serialize as numbers, not objects.
