typeDeclarations.source: export type KnowledgeAssertionInput={assertionId?:string;companySlug:string;predicate:CompanyKnowledgePredicate;value:unknown;source:{kind:KnowledgeSourceKind;ref:string};validFrom:string;validToExclusive?:string;certainty?:"confirmed"|"probable"|"uncertain";actor:string;principal:KnowledgePrincipal};
export type CompanyKnowledgePredicate = typeof COMPANY_KNOWLEDGE_PREDICATES[number];
export type KnowledgeSourceKind = "user"|"registry"|"party"|"corporate_record"|"external_snapshot"|"canonical_setting";
export type KnowledgePrincipal = { kind:"user"|"service_account"|"local_operator"; id:string };
export type KnowledgeReviewState = "proposed"|"approved"|"rejected"|"superseded"|"conflict";

producerDefinitions.source: export function proposeCompanyKnowledge(db:Database,input:KnowledgeAssertionInput){if(!COMPANY_KNOWLEDGE_PREDICATES.includes(input.predicate))throw new Error("unsupported knowledge predicate");if(!sources.includes(input.source.kind))throw new Error("unsupported knowledge source");const auditedActor=text(input.actor,"actor",160),principalId=text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160);const valueJson=canonical(input.value);if(valueJson.length>32768)throw new Error("knowledge value is too large");const validFrom=iso(input.validFrom,"validFrom"),validTo=input.validToExclusive?iso(input.validToExclusive,"validToExclusive"):null;if(validTo&&validTo<=validFrom)throw new Error("validToExclusive must be after validFrom");const companySlug=text(input.companySlug,"companySlug",120),sourceRef=text(input.source.ref,"source ref",512),assertionId=input.assertionId?text(input.assertionId,"assertionId",80):`knowledge-${randomUUID()}`;sourceExists(db,input.source.kind,sourceRef);const existing=db.query("SELECT assertion_id FROM rm_company_knowledge_assertions WHERE company_slug=? AND predicate=? AND value_hash=? AND source_kind=? AND source_ref=? AND valid_from=? AND COALESCE(valid_to_exclusive,'')=COALESCE(?, '')").get(companySlug,input.predicate,hash(valueJson),input.source.kind,sourceRef,validFrom,validTo)as{assertion_id:string}|null; if(existing)return inspectCompanyKnowledgeAssertion(db,existing.assertion_id)!;db.transaction(()=>{db.query("INSERT INTO rm_company_knowledge_assertions(assertion_id,company_slug,predicate,value_json,value_hash,source_kind,source_ref,valid_from,valid_to_exclusive,certainty,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(assertionId,companySlug,input.predicate,valueJson,hash(valueJson),input.source.kind,sourceRef,validFrom,validTo,input.certainty??"confirmed",auditedActor,input.principal.kind,principalId,new Date().toISOString());event(db,assertionId,"proposed",{...input,actor:auditedActor,principal:{...input.principal,id:principalId}});})();return inspectCompanyKnowledgeAssertion(db,assertionId)!;}

const COMPANY_KNOWLEDGE_PREDICATES = ["business_description","operating_status","products_services","revenue_models","markets","customer_types","industry_tags","operational_systems","document_sources","reporting_dimensions","responsible_party","canonical_reference"] as const;
const sources: readonly KnowledgeSourceKind[]=["user","registry","party","corporate_record","external_snapshot","canonical_setting"];
const text=(v:unknown,name:string,max=512)=>{const s=typeof v==="string"?v.trim():"";if(!s||s.length>max)throw new Error(`${name} is required and bounded`);return s;};

const canonical=(v:unknown):string=>v===null||typeof v!=="object"?JSON.stringify(v):Array.isArray(v)?`[${v.map(canonical).join(",")}]`:`{${Object.keys(v as object).sort().map(k=>`${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonical((v as any)[k])}`).join(",")}}`;
const iso=(v:unknown,name:string)=>{const d=new Date(text(v,name,64));if(Number.isNaN(d.valueOf()))throw new Error(`${name} must be ISO date/time`);return d.toISOString();};

function sourceExists(db:Database,kind:KnowledgeSourceKind,ref:string){if(kind==="party"&&!db.query("SELECT 1 FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='created'").get(ref))throw new Error("source party not found");if(kind==="corporate_record"&&!db.query("SELECT 1 FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(ref))throw new Error("source corporate record not found");}
const hash=(v:unknown)=>createHash("sha256").update(typeof v==="string"?v:canonical(v)).digest("hex");

export function inspectCompanyKnowledgeAssertion(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_company_knowledge_assertions WHERE assertion_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const history=db.query("SELECT event_type,reason,supersedes_assertion_id,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at FROM rm_company_knowledge_events WHERE assertion_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id);return {assertionId:row.assertion_id,companySlug:row.company_slug,predicate:row.predicate,value:JSON.parse(row.value_json),valueHash:row.value_hash,source:{kind:row.source_kind,ref:row.source_ref},validFrom:row.valid_from,validToExclusive:row.valid_to_exclusive,certainty:row.certainty,actor:row.actor,principal:{kind:row.principal_kind,id:row.principal_id},reviewState:current(db,id),history};}

const event=(db:Database,id:string,type:Exclude<KnowledgeReviewState,"conflict">,input:{actor:string;principal:KnowledgePrincipal;reason?:string;supersedesAssertionId?:string})=>db.query("INSERT INTO rm_company_knowledge_events(assertion_id,event_type,reason,supersedes_assertion_id,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,type,input.reason?.trim()||null,input.supersedesAssertionId?.trim()||null,text(input.actor,"actor",160),input.principal.kind,text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160),new Date().toISOString());

humanAndLocalHelpers.source: confirm = (ctx: CommandContext) => { if (ctx.arg("--confirm") !== "yes") ctx.fatal("--confirm must be exactly yes"); }
workspace = (ctx: CommandContext) => resolveWorkspaceRoot(need(ctx, "--workspace"))
need = (ctx: CommandContext, flag: string) => { const v = ctx.trimToNull(ctx.arg(flag)); if (!v) ctx.fatal(`${flag} is required`); return v!; }

json = (ctx: CommandContext, flag: string): Record<string, unknown> => { try { const v = JSON.parse(readFileSync(need(ctx, flag), "utf8")); if (!v || typeof v !== "object" || Array.isArray(v)) throw new Error("must be an object"); return v as Record<string, unknown>; } catch (e) { ctx.fatal(`${flag} must be a readable JSON object: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`); } }
actor = (ctx: CommandContext) => ctx.cliActor ?? process.env.RENTEMESTER_ACTOR ?? ctx.inferredMutationActor() ?? (() => { ctx.fatal("actor required for mutations"); })()
principal=(ctx:CommandContext)=>({kind:"local_operator" as const,id:need(ctx,"--principal-id")})

definition.handler: (ctx) => { confirm(ctx);const db=openWorkspaceControlDb(workspace(ctx));try{ctx.emitResult({ok:true,assertion:proposeCompanyKnowledge(db,{...json(ctx,"--input"),companySlug:need(ctx,"--company"),actor:actor(ctx),principal:principal(ctx)}as any)});}finally{db.close();} }

definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.

definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. Direct JSON.parse/readFileSync/inline JSON paths in the handler keep their own catches or raw runtime errors; do not normalize them.

wire.casing: Exact emissionBranches and producer definitions preserve each field name/case. SQL rows retain snake_case aliases; no global camelCase transform.
wire.nullability: Types use ? for optional properties and | null for explicit null. JSON serialization omission/null rules above apply. Unchecked SQL/JSON values follow included construction; do not narrow them to invented fields.

stdout.definition: Exact branch expressions and human formatter code below define stdout, including commands that ignore --format or print non-JSON text.

branches.typescriptType: { ok: boolean; assertion: { assertionId: any; companySlug: any; predicate: any; value: any; valueHash: any; source: { kind: any; ref: any; }; validFrom: any; validToExclusive: any; certainty: any; actor: any; principal: { kind: any; id: any; }; reviewState: KnowledgeReviewState; history: any; }; }

wire.stderr: Fatal usage/policy errors => message+LF. Generic human failures => ✘ <commandLabel> failed plus → errors/warnings/guidance. Dedicated human reports and direct console.error preserve exact source text/streams; JSON business failures remain stdout. Uncaught runtime errors may include Bun stack on stderr.

exitCodes.0: Normal completion unless handler/emitter sets failure; not a guarantee every direct-printed payload has ok:true.
exitCodes.1: emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite result.ok===false; explicit process.exit(1) or uncaught runtime exception; preserve per-handler branches.
exitCodes.2: fatal or explicit usage-error exits; actor-policy and malformed confirmation gates are usage errors, backup lock is business exit1.

wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Not applicable: CLI process has stdout/stderr, not CallToolResult. Do not wrap CLI JSON in MCP text/structuredContent.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.included: CLI argv/default/env/company-path/actor/confirmation and handler output contract only. Same core capability may exist on MCP/HTTP but transport equality is not implied.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.exclusions: MCP SDK validation/tool error envelopes and HTTP auth/status/body are excluded from this CLI row because src/cli.ts dispatches CommandContext directly, without src/mcp/tool-runtime.ts or src/server/router.ts. Exact CLI-only flags, human rendering, files and process exits have no automatic MCP/HTTP equivalent.

oracle.expectation: For company-knowledge propose, preserve openWorkspaceControlDb; proposeCompanyKnowledge. Output branches are exactly ctx.emitResult({ok:true,assertion:proposeCompanyKnowledge(db,{...json(ctx,"--input"),companySlug:need(ctx,"--company"),actor:actor(ctx),principal:principal(ctx)}as any)}). Required nested fields and nullable/optional values are the declared types plus the explicit producer construction above; no transport envelope is added.

negativeCase.scenario: Call company-knowledge propose --r01-contract-invalid value --format json (all other flags may be valid).
negativeCase.expectation: Before actor resolution, DB opening or handler execution, stderr is 'Unknown flag --r01-contract-invalid for company-knowledge propose.' followed by newline; exit 2; no structured business stdout and no business effects.

effectsAndRetry.storage: Writable openCommandDb/openDb and migrate occur where shown in handler/helper, even for read-labelled commands. Explicit openLedgerReadOnly paths must remain distinct; no safe-read/immutable guarantee inferred from help label.
effectsAndRetry.retry: No blanket idempotency guarantee. Exact producer identity/dedup/hash/revision guards included in this row are binding. Caller must retain original natural identity/idempotency key where supported; a retry without it may repeat effects. Registry safe-read inference is not evidence of harmless replay.

ORDER BY id").all(id);return {assertionId:row.assertion_id,companySlug:row.company_slug,predicate:row.predicate,value:JSON.parse(row.value_json),valueHash:row.value_hash,source:{kind:row.source_kind,ref:row.source_ref},validFrom:row.valid_from,validToExclusive:row.valid_to_exclusive,certainty:row.certainty,actor:row.actor,principal:{kind:row.principal_kind,id:row.principal_id},reviewState:current(db,id),history};}

export function inspectCompanyKnowledgeAssertion(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_company_knowledge_assertions WHERE assertion_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const history=db.query("SELECT event_type,reason,supersedes_assertion_id,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at FROM rm_company_knowledge_events WHERE assertion_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id);return {assertionId:row.assertion_id,companySlug:row.company_slug,predicate:row.predicate,value:JSON.parse(row.value_json),valueHash:row.value_hash,source:{kind:row.source_kind,ref:row.source_ref},validFrom:row.valid_from,validToExclusive:row.valid_to_exclusive,certainty:row.certainty,actor:row.actor,principal:{kind:row.principal_kind,id:row.principal_id},reviewState:current(db,id),history};}
const text=(v:unknown,name:string,max=512)=>{const s=typeof v==="string"?v.trim():"";if(!s||s.length>max)throw new Error(`${name} is required and bounded`);return s;};

export function proposeCompanyKnowledge(db:Database,input:KnowledgeAssertionInput){if(!COMPANY_KNOWLEDGE_PREDICATES.includes(input.predicate))throw new Error("unsupported knowledge predicate");if(!sources.includes(input.source.kind))throw new Error("unsupported knowledge source");const auditedActor=text(input.actor,"actor",160),principalId=text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160);const valueJson=canonical(input.value);if(valueJson.length>32768)throw new Error("knowledge value is too large");const validFrom=iso(input.validFrom,"validFrom"),validTo=input.validToExclusive?iso(input.validToExclusive,"validToExclusive"):null;if(validTo&&validTo<=validFrom)throw new Error("validToExclusive must be after validFrom");const companySlug=text(input.companySlug,"companySlug",120),sourceRef=text(input.source.ref,"source ref",512),assertionId=input.assertionId?text(input.assertionId,"assertionId",80):`knowledge-${randomUUID()}`;sourceExists(db,input.source.kind,sourceRef);const existing=db.query("SELECT assertion_id FROM rm_company_knowledge_assertions WHERE company_slug=? AND predicate=? AND value_hash=? AND source_kind=? AND source_ref=? AND valid_from=? AND COALESCE(valid_to_exclusive,'')=COALESCE(?, '')").get(companySlug,input.predicate,hash(valueJson),input.source.kind,sourceRef,validFrom,validTo)as{assertion_id:string}|null; if(existing)return inspectCompanyKnowledgeAssertion(db,existing.assertion_id)!;db.transaction(()=>{db.query("INSERT INTO rm_company_knowledge_assertions(assertion_id,company_slug,predicate,value_json,value_hash,source_kind,source_ref,valid_from,valid_to_exclusive,certainty,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(assertionId,companySlug,input.predicate,valueJson,hash(valueJson),input.source.kind,sourceRef,validFrom,validTo,input.certainty??"confirmed",auditedActor,input.principal.kind,principalId,new Date().toISOString());event(db,assertionId,"proposed",{...input,actor:auditedActor,principal:{...input.principal,id:principalId}});})();return inspectCompanyKnowledgeAssertion(db,assertionId)!;}

const COMPANY_KNOWLEDGE_PREDICATES = ["business_description","operating_status","products_services","revenue_models","markets","customer_types","industry_tags","operational_systems","document_sources","reporting_dimensions","responsible_party","canonical_reference"] as const;
const sources: readonly KnowledgeSourceKind[]=["user","registry","party","corporate_record","external_snapshot","canonical_setting"];

const event=(db:Database,id:string,type:Exclude<KnowledgeReviewState,"conflict">,input:{actor:string;principal:KnowledgePrincipal;reason?:string;supersedesAssertionId?:string})=>db.query("INSERT INTO rm_company_knowledge_events(assertion_id,event_type,reason,supersedes_assertion_id,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,type,input.reason?.trim()||null,input.supersedesAssertionId?.trim()||null,text(input.actor,"actor",160),input.principal.kind,text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160),new Date().toISOString());

producerDefinitions.source: export function queryOwnershipGraph(db:Database,input:{asOf:string;visibleCompanySlugs?:ReadonlySet<string>}) { const asOf=date(input.asOf,"asOf"),ends=storedEndings(db);const all=approvedRows(db).map(row=>withEnd(JSON.parse(row.canonical_fact)as OwnershipFactInput,ends.get(row.fact_hash))).filter(f=>active(f,asOf));const visible=input.visibleCompanySlugs;const facts=visible?all.filter(f=>visible.has(f.ownedCompanySlug)&&(f.owner.kind!=="company"||visible.has(f.owner.companySlug))):all;const hidden=!!visible&&facts.length!==all.length;return {asOf,facts,partial:hidden,consolidation:{eligible:false,reason:hidden?"hidden endpoints":all.some(f=>f.owner.kind!=="company"||f.economicBasisPoints==null||f.validToExclusive!=null)?"party, interval or non-exact ownership requires explicit supported scope":"existing v1 manifest remains authoritative"}}; }

const date = (v: unknown, label: string) => { const s = text(v, label, 10); if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s) || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(`${s}T00:00:00Z`))) throw new Error(`${label} must be an ISO date`); return s; };

definition.centralActorAndBackupGate: For keys in MUTATING_COMMANDS only: explicit --actor then trimmed RENTEMESTER_ACTOR; canonical /^(user|agent|system):\S.+$/; otherwise OPENCLAW_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_AGENT, RENTEMESTER_USER, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME in that order. Explicit and inferred actors both checked case-insensitively against policy actor_allowlist, original spelling retained. Empty allowlist rejects user but permits agent/system. Restore of fresh target with no policy bypasses allowlist only, not canonical identity. --actor-via/RENTEMESTER_ACTOR_VIA defaults rentemester-cli for explicit actor. Handler-scoped workspace writes resolve target policy themselves. Documents parse/parse-pending and period review/close require exactly --confirm yes before actor. expense vat-preflight/system migrate skip mutation gate unless --apply yes; other --apply values fatal. Non-system mutations with existing company DB open writable lockDb, migrate, evaluateBackupLock; locked emits {ok:false,errors:[Danish actionable message],backupLock:{locked:true,command:string}} and exit1. No blanket confirm gate beyond these: inspect each handler.
definition.streams: fatal/explicit console.error => stderr and exit2 where specified; emitResult/emitHumanReport/emitHumanWrite ok:false => JSON stdout or human stderr and process.exitCode=1. Direct logging exceptions are retained in exact handler; unhandled thrown errors are Bun runtime errors (normally exit1), not fabricated ok:false envelopes.

definition.argv: argv.slice(2): flags Map<string,string|true>, last duplicate wins; positionals string[] preserve order. -- terminates option parsing. Value flags accept --name=value (including empty and leading dashes) or --name <token not starting -->. Boolean flags reject attached values and consume/reject a following non-option token. Unknown flags rejected before actor/handler. Only first two positionals dispatch; remaining positionals are available to handlers. --json overrides --format even when --format invalid; otherwise --format json|human; absent => human on stdout TTY, JSON otherwise. --help and registered --example exit before actor/handler; --example writes exact registered file bytes. No implicit flag alias rewriting.

Bare slug resolves against configured RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE and must be registered; without configured workspace it is a raw path. Raw paths containing .. segments refused; resolve absolute. Workspace/bootstrap/group policy exceptions and --workspace handling remain handler-specific as in executable boundary below.
definition.fileInput: Only handlers using readJsonCliInput/readJsonObjectCliInput receive caught file errors: ENOENT, EACCES/EPERM, EISDIR, other read errors and malformed JSON => fatal stderr exit2. readJsonObjectCliInput additionally refuses null, arrays, primitives. applyOwnershipSnapshot(db:Database,input:{snapshotId:string;snapshotHash:string;diffHash:string;actor:string;principal:OwnershipPrincipal;authorized:boolean}) { if(!input.authorized)throw new Error("ownership apply requires live narrow workspace permission");const id=text(input.snapshotId,"snapshotId",80), snapshot=inspectSnapshot(db,id);if(!snapshot)throw new Error("ownership snapshot not found");if(snapshot.snapshotHash!==input.snapshotHash||snapshot.diffHash!==input.diffHash)throw new Error("exact snapshot and diff hashes are required");if(state(db,id)==="applied")return {status:"unchanged" as const,snapshot};if(state(db,id)!=="approved")throw new Error("only an approved ownership snapshot can be applied");const actor=text(input.actor,"actor",160),pid=text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160);let applied=false;db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");try{const fresh=inspectSnapshot(db,id)!;if(state(db,id)!=="applied"){if(fresh.snapshotHash!==input.snapshotHash||fresh.diffHash!==input.diffHash||state(db,id)!=="approved")throw new Error("ownership snapshot became stale before apply");const additions=fresh.diff.add as OwnershipFactInput[];const endings=assertGraphIntegrity(db,additions);if(canonical(endings)!==canonical(fresh.diff.endings??[]))throw new Error("ownership snapshot became stale against current approved facts");for(const item of additions){const canonicalFact=canonical(item), factHash=sha(item);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_ownership_facts(fact_id,snapshot_id,fact_hash,canonical_fact,owner_kind,owner_id,owned_company_slug,valid_from,valid_to_exclusive,economic_exact_bp,economic_min_bp,economic_max_bp,voting_bp,control_type,share_class,jurisdiction,review_state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(`ownership-fact-${factHash.slice(0,32)}`,id,factHash,canonicalFact,item.owner.kind,item.owner.kind==="company"?item.owner.companySlug:item.owner.partyId,item.ownedCompanySlug,item.validFrom,item.validToExclusive??null,item.economicBasisPoints??null,item.economicIntervalBasisPoints?.min??null,item.economicIntervalBasisPoints?.max??null,item.votingBasisPoints??null,item.controlType,item.shareClass??null,item.jurisdiction,"approved",new Date().toISOString());}for(const end of endings)db.query("INSERT INTO rm_ownership_fact_events(fact_hash,event_type,effective_to_exclusive,successor_fact_hash,snapshot_id,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(end.factHash,"ended",end.effectiveToExclusive,end.successorFactHash,id,actor,input.principal.kind,pid,new Date().toISOString());db.query("INSERT INTO rm_ownership_snapshot_events(snapshot_id,event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,"applied",actor,input.principal.kind,pid,new Date().toISOString());applied=true;}db.exec("COMMIT");}catch(error){try{db.exec("ROLLBACK");}catch{}throw error;}return {status:applied?"applied" as const:"unchanged" as const,snapshot:inspectSnapshot(db,id)!}; }

ORDER BY id").all(snapshotId)}; }

producerDefinitions.source: export function projectExactCompanyOwnership(db:Database,asOf:string) { const graph=queryOwnershipGraph(db,{asOf});if(graph.consolidation.reason!=="existing v1 manifest remains authoritative")return {eligible:false as const,reason:graph.consolidation.reason,edges:[]};const byChild=new Map<string,number>();for(const f of graph.facts){byChild.set(f.ownedCompanySlug,(byChild.get(f.ownedCompanySlug)??0)+f.economicBasisPoints!);}if([...byChild.values()].some(n=>n!==10000))return {eligible:false as const,reason:"incomplete or minority ownership totals",edges:[]};return {eligible:true as const,edges:graph.facts.map(f=>({parentCompanySlug:(f.owner as any).companySlug,childCompanySlug:f.ownedCompanySlug,basisPoints:f.economicBasisPoints!}))}; }

export function queryOwnershipGraph(db:Database,input:{asOf:string;visibleCompanySlugs?:ReadonlySet<string>}) { const asOf=date(input.asOf,"asOf"),ends=storedEndings(db);const all=approvedRows(db).map(row=>withEnd(JSON.parse(row.canonical_fact)as OwnershipFactInput,ends.get(row.fact_hash))).filter(f=>active(f,asOf));const visible=input.visibleCompanySlugs;const facts=visible?all.filter(f=>visible.has(f.ownedCompanySlug)&&(f.owner.kind!=="company"||visible.has(f.owner.companySlug))):all;const hidden=!!visible&&facts.length!==all.length;return {asOf,facts,partial:hidden,consolidation:{eligible:false,reason:hidden?"hidden endpoints":all.some(f=>f.owner.kind!=="company"||f.economicBasisPoints==null||f.validToExclusive!=null)?"party, interval or non-exact ownership requires explicit supported scope":"existing v1 manifest remains authoritative"}}; }
